page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.8xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system provides 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs, resulting in a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The processor includes a 35 MB L3 cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 KB L1d cache, with support for AVX, AVX-512F, AES cryptography, and BMI2 instructions.

This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, relying entirely on external storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included. In benchmark evaluations, the single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by lower scores in stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, as well as poor single-threaded gzip compression. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests all placing in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth tests for both read and write operations also demonstrate average performance.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.se1.8xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high single-threaded compute performance. The high memory density makes it suitable for database operations, caching layers, and multi-threaded processing tasks, which are supported by average Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput. It is also capable of handling moderate LLM inference tasks for small and medium models, though text generation speeds for smaller models are weak. This instance is best deployed for memory-heavy applications, multi-threaded data processing, and general-purpose enterprise workloads.
